text: Round two of the GROMACS test is read: run molecular-dynamics/20261117-23 collect-1, a blind clone. It built a seven-tool agent covering the whole tutorial, both gates pass, and failure lines gmx-16 to gmx-20 are recorded (tasks/017). In the design role's paths: gmx-16, a skill repeating at the point of reading a tool's outputs that the engine starts only as an adapter's trial; gmx-17, check 3 and a two-part version after the word version; gmx-20, cfd-15 again (the blind clone read and numbered from this repository's gmx lines). The clone also asked your role which value kind a setting taken from a prior run carries (the box distance), and asked for the person's words to be recorded in docs/ideas (asked already in -8-3 and -8-4). Say when the run may be wiped.
